hook: *578* drunk drivers caught in two days of Hyderabad checks
hook_b: *578* drunk drivers caught in two days of Hyderabad checks
tldr: A two-day Hyderabad traffic police drive on Nov 6–7 booked 578 people for driving under the influence.

beats.what: Hyderabad traffic police booked 578 motorists for drunk driving in a two-day special drive on Nov 6–7, as reported by The Hindu and two other outlets.
beats.why: The city runs weekend special drives against drunk driving; this one fell in the Deepavali week.
beats.care: Cases booked in these drives go to court; riding home after a party is the main catch zone.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Hindu: 578 caught driving under influence in a two-day Hyderabad traffic police drive. 495 were on two-wheelers; 5 recorded blood alcohol above 300 mg/100 ml.

cards.q: Should weekend drunk-driving checks run every night?

viz.l: booked for drunk driving in 2 days

viz.verdict: Most offenders were on bikes and scooters

cover.label: booked for drunk driving in 2 days

learn.t: BAC = blood alcohol concentration; the legal limit in India is 30 mg per 100 ml of blood.
